scope: Read-only source review, in-memory transport reproduction, and offline rendering of saved actual observations; no hardware

findings.title: Empty-text exceptions bypass the retained-owner lockout
findings.method: Use tests/conftest.py fictional config and FakeTransport; interrupt pulse hold with unittest.mock.patch.object(channel.cancel, wait, side_effect=KeyboardInterrupt()); catch it, then request ON again on the same owner. No instrument transport is constructed.

observed.journal_after_interrupt: Protective OFF pending; original=; optical state unknown

findings.cause: _fault stores str(exc), empty for KeyboardInterrupt; _ready at724 treats an empty error as no fault. The disk journal still blocks a later process, but the retained owner can send another ON.
findings.proposed_correction: Store a nonempty exception description and make fault-state checking consistent; add an interruption regression asserting no subsequent ON before protected recovery.

findings.title: Retained fault hides successful protective OFF feedback
findings.method: Render final-protective-off-result from records/webui-command-hardware-live.json through the current Dash HTTP callback, offline.

observed.recorded_cleanup: Electrical OFF readback; dispatch monotonic=309283.930783; optical unknown

findings.cause: The fault-notice branch discards the successful action message while connected, and render at935-936 forces electrical Output to Unknown for every fault, even with a fresh sample.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep fault/activation lockout while also reporting the confirmed OFF action and dated electrical result; retain optical state Unknown.
